MATERIAL_PHOTO_CRAFT.description: Material, craft, authentic asset and photo direction. Hearts adds a regional-SME example where real people and product evidence remain the visual authority.

B2B_EXPLAINER_DOCUMENT.description: Complex B2B/product information translated into customer-comprehensible language. All three are traceable M3 references for P02-class comparisons.

CUSTOMER_WORLD_TRANSLATION.description: Formal opponent pool for P02: specialist/product language must become language a customer can immediately understand and act on.

PRICE_TRANSPARENCY.description: Formal opponent pool for P09: published price, scope/plan drivers and next-step clarity. Four visually reviewed M3 references cover bespoke production pricing, packaged service pricing and SaaS plan architecture.

CUSTOMER_STATE_TRANSITION.description: Formal opponent pool for P10: uncertainty before consultation must become language, orientation and a credible next step.

TYPOGRAPHY_MOTION.description: Typography, semantic motion and authored rhythm.

UTILITY_ACCESSIBILITY_TRUST.description: Premium through clarity, trust and accessible utility rather than visual excess.

CONVERSION_ACTION.description: Action design and low-friction next steps, including pricing and local-service contexts.

MOBILE_FIRST.description: Mobile composition quality and responsive re-art-direction backed by visually reviewed M3 live evidence.

ASSET_LIGHT.description: Concept/typography-led references for limited-asset sales samples; not templates.

LOCAL_SME_TRANSFER.description: Transferable principles for NO_WEB/WEAK_WEB local SME sales samples. The pool prioritizes regional/small-business examples with real work, local identity, people, product or service-specific craft instead of relying on large-company stand-ins.

BUSINESS_VERB.description: A real business verb or behavior generates form, rhythm or motion.

EMOTIONAL_BARRIER.description: Art direction lowers the psychological barrier to reading, consulting or acting. The career references add explicit uncertainty-to-consultation patterns for P10-class work.
